name: vmware-embeddings-large-v1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.109 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2025-12-09. Caveat, deliberately recorded: the card is visibly templated (the copyright line still reads 'Copyright (c) 2024 [Your Name]', the 'name' is 'vmware-embeddings-large-v1' while the base is BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 at 0.109B params - 'large' is a label, not a size) and the repo bundles a dev-split eval CSV whose numbers differ from the card's table (dev R@1 0.744 vs card test R@1 0.759). Both sets of numbers are real and consistent in direction; the card table is what is recorded here because it is the only place the base column exists.

benchmarks.name: VMware technical-docs retrieval Recall@1
benchmarks.config: Card 'Performance / Evaluation Metrics' table, column 'Fine-tuned' Recall@1 0.759 vs column 'Base Model' 0.637; held-out 2,000-query technical-docs test set. The repo's own bundled Information-Retrieval_evaluation_vmware-dev_results.csv is the DEV split and reports 0.744 Recall@1 / 0.872 NDCG@10 for epoch 1 step 10500 - close but not the card's test-split figures.

benchmarks.name: VMware technical-docs retrieval NDCG@3
benchmarks.config: Card figure comparison.png, third subplot 'NDCG@k', printed data label on the 'Fine-tuned' bar. Read off a figure, not the card's HTML table: +/-0.5 read-by-eye caveat, though the label is printed rather than estimated and a second crop read matched every digit. Held-out 2,000-query technical-docs test set; base model BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 0.737 for comparison. NDCG@1 falls back to 0.759 and NDCG@10 0.879, both already recorded from the card table, so they are not re-added here.
